# The liability side of two_usd_bought_for_2_01_cad_and_sold_a_dollar_at_a_time.txt:
# supplies of 2.01 CAD charged to a US dollar card as 2.00 USD, so the book
# owes 2.00 USD that cost 1.005 CAD each, then 1.00 USD paid off at a time for
# 1.40 CAD. The first repayment is valued at its share of the cost rounded,
# 1.005, half up, 1.01, with a realized loss of 0.39.
#
# The second, the last of that cost basis, is in
# ..._the_last_at_what_is_left.txt: valued at what is left, 1.00, with a loss
# of 0.40, so the two come to the realized loss of 2.80 − 2.01 = 0.79. Valued
# at its own share, 1.01, as the first, the book records 0.78.
#
# Verified by
# tests/integration/test_a_balance_sheet_states_the_realized_gain_the_book_did_not_record.py.
